assessment_objectives.objective: Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) are defined for data that requires replication.
data is replicated to alternate storage or processing locations.
the replication frequency or replication lag for each replicated data set is configured so that it does not exceed the Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of that data.
replication status is monitored and replication failures or lag exceeding the Recovery Point Objective (RPO) generate alerts that are investigated and resolved.
the ability of replicated data to satisfy Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs) is validated at a defined frequency and the results are documented.
